Job Title
Portfolio Advisor
Unit/Department
Consumer Banking
Location
Hong Kong

2025/12/30
Job Status
Full Time

Main Responsibilities

- Drive sales activities to assist branches in delivering their investment business
- Act as point of contact for all branches on investment enquiries related to mutual funds /structured products/bonds
- Perform joint call with relationship managers to review client portfolio and present investment ideas to clients
- Provide backup and support in business activities, i.e. seminars and promotion programs so to achieve investment sales target
- Constant update of product knowledge on mutual funds and investment products to all branches
- Provide training and coaching to frontline associates
- Perform portfolio review and formulate investment strategy for high networth clients. Able to offer tailored investment planning advice and develop investment proposal for sophisticated clients
- Liaise with relevant internal departments on compliance, marketing, operations and systems issues
- Represent the Bank in working with external business partners, i.e. fund management companies

Requirements

- University graduate with at least 5 years relevant sales experience in investment products, experience in mutual fund, FX and structured products is a must
- Possess HKSI qualification or equivalent
- CFP / CFA qualification preferred
- Excellent knowledge in mutual fund, FX and investment products
- Good command of written and spoken English, Cantonese and Putonghua
- Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
- The employment is subject to Mandatory Reference Checking Scheme (MRCS) as per regulatory requirement.

To apply, please submit your application along with your resume to "recruithk@asia.ccb.com".
Applicants who are not contacted within 8 weeks may consider their applications unsuccessful and their personal data will be retained by the bank for a period up to two years.

All information provided by applicants will be used for recruitment purposes only and will be used strictly in accordance with the bank’s personal data policies, a copy of which will be provided upon request.
